name: r9-vectors-host-work-control
note: Control records (delegated host-work I.5.3 to I.5.5, II.3.1; host-work-v1 §11.1; planned: host.senders, not advertised). Wire {"body":{…},"sig"}; signing input enc(["atem-host-work-control-v1", jcs(body)]) (R9.1). The device list is r9-vectors-membership-log's log L followed by `chain` (labels of its others); signers' keys are r9-vectors-keys' (`signed_with`). A service record's principal_key is the r9_svc of the principal's auth_key (SHA-256 of its raw bytes, decision 8), written beside it. `checks`: verify_control's verdict on each chain (valid with the verified signer and, for the principal's own key, the seq that enrolled it; pending or refused with its reason); `parse_error`: the record's parse refuses it (in a feed, refused per record and kept as evidence; over a channel the whole control_records message is invalid_request). `sequences`: ControlState::apply on one host, step by step (the record, the list of the transaction, its feed position or none over a channel, host-work's applied device-list seq) with the record's result, each effect's result, the host's actions and whether the record is kept as evidence; each step applies to the state the step before it left; `state` is ControlState::to_json after the last step (v2: one part per principal, `principals`; each part names its device list, account_id and genesis_hash, and its `records` are the [record_id, digest, issued_at] triples that counted, oldest first; `order` holds one feed per Station origin). A step's position is {origin, feed_id, feed_seq}: a record counts as read at its own feed's position only when origin and feed_id are its body's. Record ids are UUID v4 numbered by record (the X* records and V6_conflicting_id reuse another record's id on purpose). Atem's proposals, for Astation's and Auth/Portal's agreement: covers are ordered by (issued_at, record_id); a hold applies from any feed, a release only from the covering feed after its cover and after that feed's last hold or release; record ids are per principal, and another body under an id the same principal's record counted with is evidence (a stop still applies, a cover or release is refused). Each step's `standing` is ControlState::standing of its record's principal after it (held, interrupted, and revoked and coverage {origin, feed_id} when there are). Its `expect.why` is Applied::why's code (host-work-v1 §11.1: the verifier's pending or refusal reason, or list_frozen, not_revoked, revoke_not_applied, order, after_revoke, collision, not_newer, possible_replay, not_after_hold), present exactly when the record is pending or refused or kept as evidence. A sequence with `initial` starts from that state (ControlState::to_json) instead of a new one: its records of svc-discord that aren't the file's are the record `fill`'s body under those record ids (each signed by svc-discord's key and counted, at no position), so svc-discord's records start full. A principal keeps at most 256 counted record ids (MAX_RECORD_IDS): the next evicts the oldest, never the revocation's record nor the coverage's cover, and raises the part's `evicted_floor` to the newest issued_at evicted; a cover or release of a principal not revoked, under an id not counted and issued no later than the floor, is refused as a possible replay and kept as evidence; a hold, revoke or interrupt never is (decision 19, rulings T4a and T4d, agreed with Astation on 2026-11-13, #120 comment 6848326392). A service's part keeps `hold_issued_at`, the newest issued_at of every hold verified while it wasn't revoked (one that held or found it held, read out of order, from another feed, at no position or under a counted id), never lowered or cleared; a release taken in feed order while held lifts the hold only when issued strictly after it, else it is refused with why not_after_hold (no evidence) and takes no position in the feed's order (O1, requested in Astation's review of PR 2, #120 comment 6848326392; for Astation's sign-off). Each effect pending or refused in `expect` carries the step's why (O5, for Astation's sign-off).

records.note: station-b's pause

records.label: A2_hold
records.note: the snapshot's pause, signed anew after its cover

records.label: A2_release

records.label: M3_revoke_by_removed_manager

records.label: M4_revoke_resigned

records.note: signed by dev-newmac: not in L, then the subject of a recovery_add still waiting (R7), then a manager once A8 approves it

records.label: M6_hold_by_manager

records.label: H1_interrupt_7
records.note: interrupt host-a's tasks admitted before its revoke at seq 7 (HS7_revoke): pending until the list holds that revoke

records.label: H2_interrupt_7_again
records.note: another record for the same revoke_seq

records.label: H3_interrupt_12
records.note: for HS12_revoke_interrupt, a revoke that carried interrupt_running: true

records.label: H4_interrupt_not_a_revoke
records.note: revoke_seq 2 names E2 (host-a's add_host), not a revoke of host-a

records.label: H5_interrupt_unknown_host
records.note: host-b has no add_host in the list yet

records.label: H6_host_key_signed
records.note: signed by host-a's own host_key: a host's key signs no control record

records.label: V1_wrong_account
records.note: another account_id

records.label: V2_bad_signature
records.note: svc-discord's signature with its first byte flipped

records.label: V3_key_mismatch
records.note: principal_key names dev-mac's key, not svc-discord's (r9_svc beside it is svc-discord's)

records.label: V4_not_a_service
records.note: service:dev-phone names a native member

records.label: V5_principal_unknown
records.note: service:svc-new isn't in the list yet (its principal_key names a key the list doesn't hold)

records.label: V6_conflicting_id
records.note: S1_cover's record_id with another body: valid by itself; a host that counted S1_cover refuses it and keeps it as evidence

records.label: P1_host_release
records.note: a host principal's release: refused at parse

records.label: P2_service_revoke_seq
records.note: revoke_seq on a service's record

records.label: P3_host_feed
records.note: origin and feed_id on a host principal's record (bound to no feed)

records.label: P4_unknown_field
records.note: a field the body doesn't have

records.label: P5_by_not_a_label
records.note: about.by outside [a-z_]

records.label: P6_no_integration_id
records.note: a service's record without about.integration_id

records.label: P7_hold_interrupt_running
records.note: interrupt_running beside an action other than revoke

records.label: A2_cover_not_newer
records.note: station-dev's reset snapshot cover, signed with a clock behind S1_cover's: not newer, so the coverage stays on the old feed

records.label: S9_hold
records.note: a pause applied out of feed order (say it waited)

records.label: S10_release
records.note: a resume at a position before the feed's last hold or release

records.label: S11_release
records.note: a resume after the feed's last hold or release

records.label: T1_cover_tie_lower_id
records.note: station-dev's cover issued at the same time as T2_cover_tie, with a lower record_id

records.label: T2_cover_tie
records.note: station-b's cover

records.label: T3_cover_tie_higher_id
records.note: station-dev's cover issued at the same time as T2_cover_tie, with a higher record_id: newer

records.label: X1_cover_under_h1_id
records.note: svc-discord's own cover under the record_id of H1_interrupt_7 (host-a's): a record of another principal never blocks it

records.label: X2_hold_under_s3_id
records.note: a pause under S3_release's record_id: a stop, it applies, and the reused id is evidence

records.label: X3_release_under_s2_id
records.note: a resume under S2_hold's record_id: refused, and the reused id is evidence

records.label: X4_revoke_under_s1_id
records.note: a revoke with interrupt_running under S1_cover's record_id: a stop, it applies, and the reused id is evidence

records.label: F1_hold
records.note: a pause issued after every record the bound evicted: it applies

records.label: F2_hold
records.note: another pause issued after them, while one is in force: a duplicate

records.label: F3_release
records.note: a resume issued after them: it applies

records.label: W1_release_withheld
records.note: a resume issued half a second before S9_hold: a carrier that withheld it serves it after that hold

records.label: W2_release_refused_before
records.note: a resume issued a quarter second before S9_hold, refused once (out of feed order) and served again after it

records.label: W3_release_newer
records.note: a resume issued after every hold of the file: it lifts them

records.label: W4_release_tie
records.note: a resume issued in the same millisecond as S2_hold

records.label: W5_release_after_tie
records.note: a resume issued one millisecond after S2_hold

records.label: W6_release_before_b4
records.note: a resume issued half a second before B4_hold

records.label: W7_release_before_x2
records.note: a resume issued half a second before X2_hold_under_s3_id

records.label: W8_b_release_newer
records.note: station-b's resume issued after every hold of the file

sequences.label: Q1_service_on_one_feed
sequences.note: cover, hold, release, then the revocation from the Station and from a native manager, its interrupt added later, and a pause after it

sequences.label: Q2_removed_manager_then_resigned
sequences.note: a stop signed by a manager removed before the host received it is refused (evidence); its re-signed copy applies

sequences.label: Q3_pending_signer
sequences.note: a record whose native signer the list doesn't hold yet waits, and applies once its recovery took effect

sequences.label: Q4_cover_from_another_station
sequences.note: covers are ordered by (issued_at, record_id): a stale cover from another Station neither takes coverage nor releases; a newer one takes coverage and the hold persists until the new feed releases

sequences.label: Q5_feed_reset
sequences.note: a reset's newer cover (a duplicate) moves the ordering to the new feed; the old feed's release no longer applies

sequences.label: Q6_feed_reset_on_a_new_host
sequences.note: a host that never saw the old feed applies the snapshot: no stop is lost; the old feed's older cover is a duplicate that moves nothing back

sequences.label: Q7_host_interrupt
sequences.note: revoke_seq names that host's own revoke: pending until the list holds it and host-work applied it (host_applied_seq); one interrupt per revoke_seq; a revoke entry with interrupt_running: true already interrupted

sequences.label: Q8_refused_and_kept_as_evidence
sequences.note: verification refusals and a reused record_id are evidence; a pending record is not

sequences.label: Q9_unknown_by_applies
sequences.note: an about.by no host knows applies: about decides nothing

sequences.label: Q10_hold_from_a_station_that_lost_the_takeover
sequences.note: a stop always wins: the hold of a Station whose cover wasn't newer applies; its release is refused; the covering feed's release issued before that hold leaves it (amended for O1), the covering feed's release issued after it lifts it, and the hold replayed is a duplicate

sequences.label: Q11_reset_cover_not_newer
sequences.note: a reset whose snapshot cover isn't newer leaves the coverage on the old feed: the new feed's hold applies, its release is refused, the old feed's release issued before that hold leaves it (amended for O1), and the old feed's release issued after it lifts it

sequences.label: Q12_service_interrupt_waits
sequences.note: a service's interrupt_running waits for the service's revocation on this host, then applies once

sequences.label: Q13_out_of_order_in_one_feed
sequences.note: within the covering feed a hold applied out of feed order still applies; a release must come after the feed's last hold or release

sequences.label: Q14_hold_with_no_coverage
sequences.note: a hold applies with no coverage at all; a release needs the covering feed, after its cover

sequences.label: Q15_old_cover_replayed_after_a_move
sequences.note: the old Station's cover replayed after the coverage moved is a duplicate that moves nothing back: the old feed's hold still applies, its release doesn't

sequences.label: Q16_issued_at_tie
sequences.note: covers issued at the same time are ordered by record_id: the lower one doesn't take coverage, the higher one does

sequences.label: Q17_record_ids_per_principal
sequences.note: a record of one principal under another principal's record_id blocks nothing: idempotency is by principal and record_id

sequences.label: Q18_colliding_record_ids
sequences.note: another body under a record_id the same principal's record counted with is evidence, and the first body keeps the id: a stop (hold, revoke) still applies, a release or cover is refused

sequences.label: Q19_evicted_records_replayed_are_refused
sequences.note: a principal keeps at most 256 counted record ids, oldest first, never evicting the coverage's cover, and its evicted floor is the newest issued_at evicted (decision 19, rulings T4a and T4d, agreed with Astation on 2026-11-13, #120 comment 6848326392): from svc-discord covered, held, released and full (S1_cover, S2_hold, S3_release, then 253 copies of S3_release), F1_hold holds and evicts S2_hold, F2_hold evicts S3_release; S3_release re-served at a fresh position of the covering feed is a possible replay, refused and kept as evidence, so the hold stays (feed_seq isn't signed: a carrier that controls positions could otherwise lift it); F3_release, issued after the floor, lifts it; S2_hold replayed holds again, since the floor guards only covers and releases (a stop always wins, and a hold grants nothing); B1_cover_stale, issued before the floor, is refused as a possible replay

sequences.label: Q20_evicted_revoke_still_duplicate
sequences.note: the record that revoked a principal is never evicted; another revoke evicted and replayed is verified again and is still a duplicate, since no evicted floor applies to a revoke or an interrupt (a replay of one is a duplicate, a new one a stop): from svc-discord revoked and full (S4_revoke, M1_revoke, then 254 copies of S4_revoke), S5_revoke_interrupt adds the interrupt and evicts M1_revoke, which comes back a duplicate, as S4_revoke (pinned) and a later interrupt do; a hold issued before the floor is ignored by rule 7 (refused, no evidence), not taken for a replay

sequences.label: Q21_release_issued_before_a_newer_hold
sequences.note: a release lifts a hold only when issued strictly after every hold verified for the principal (O1): a release a carrier withheld, and one refused before (out of feed order), each served in feed order after a newer hold, are refused and leave the hold; neither takes a position in the feed's order; a release issued after the hold lifts it

sequences.label: Q22_release_at_the_holds_time
sequences.note: the tie rule is conservative: a release issued in the same millisecond as the hold leaves it; one issued a millisecond later lifts it

sequences.label: Q23_newer_hold_while_held
sequences.note: a newer hold while held is a duplicate, yet its time is kept: a release issued after the hold in force but before the newer one leaves the principal held

sequences.label: Q24_holds_from_another_feed_no_position_or_a_colliding_id
sequences.note: every verified hold's time counts, wherever it was read: station-b's hold (a feed that doesn't cover), a hold over a channel (no position) and a hold under a counted record id (evidence, applied as a stop); a release of the covering feed issued before each is refused, one issued after them all lifts the hold

sequences.label: Q25_hold_time_kept_across_restart_and_eviction
sequences.note: the hold's time is part of the stored state (hold_issued_at) and no restart or eviction erases it: from svc-discord covered, held and full (S1_cover, S2_hold, then 254 copies of S9_hold), read as a host reads its stored state, S3_release is refused (issued before the copies' hold); F1_hold evicts S2_hold, so the evicted floor is S2_hold's time, below W1_release_withheld's: the floor can't stop that release, the hold's time does; W3_release_newer lifts the hold

sequences.label: Q26_hold_time_kept_across_reset_and_coverage_change
sequences.note: no reset or coverage change erases the hold's time: after a reset (A2_cover moves the order to the new feed) the new feed's release issued before the hold is refused; after another Station takes the coverage over, its release issued before the hold is refused too; its release issued after the hold lifts it

sequences.label: Q27_no_release_after_a_revoke
sequences.note: a revoke stays final: no release, however new, lifts the hold, and the hold stays in force
